task: T3 Flutter extension GL proc gap

driver_oracle.finding: OH Mali(r32p0) eglGetProcAddress returns NULL for 59 of 289 candidate ext procs; Android Mali-G57(r54p1) NULL for 18. oh_gap (NULL on OH, non-NULL on Android) = 41 procs, and ALL 41 are present as direct dlsym exports in OH libGLESv2/libGLESv3. So on OH these extension entry points exist in the driver but are NOT reachable through eglGetProcAddress -- confirming the DIGEST premise. Impeller's cbz-guarded loader skips the NULL store, leaving slot #468 = 0. FIX: interpose eglGetProcAddress and, for a NULL result, return dlsym(libGLESv2/v3,name) (a real driver export, not a stub).

fix.design: GLES shim staged as native_library; interpose eglGetProcAddress: (1) real eglGetProcAddress; (2) if NULL, dlsym libGLESv2 then libGLESv3 (real driver export -> forward); (3) if still NULL, gl* no-op stub logging [gles_shim] CALLED (only for proven non-load-bearing). All 41 oh_gap procs are case (2) forwardable.
fix.status: designed; deployment/verification blocked by (a) bionic-namespace injection and (b) libflutter app_lib load race -- see blockers.

injection_blocker.summary: libflutter loads via --android-native-target into an isolated bionic namespace; eglGetProcAddress resolves against /system/lib64/platformsdk/libEGL.so inside it. Parent LD_PRELOAD is taken by the bionic shim and does not reach the namespace; --android-native-target only intercepts app-dlopen'd libs (recorder never loaded, confirmed absent from child maps).
injection_blocker.identified_path: stage shim as /data/local/tmp/asx/lib/arm64-v8a/libEGL.so (namespace-searched first), soname distinct, absolute DT_NEEDED to /system/lib64/platformsdk/libEGL.so so other egl* resolve to the real lib while only eglGetProcAddress is interposed (policy-compliant).
